name: personal-ai
title: Personal AI
description: Ask Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Ollama, or Apple Intelligence with your own accounts, and open prompts in the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps.
author: csa819

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask
commands.subtitle: Personal AI
commands.description: Type a prompt and read the reply in Raycast. Pick the provider, model, and thinking level for this run.

commands.name: ask-claude
commands.title: Ask Claude
commands.subtitle: Anthropic
commands.description: Ask Claude with your Anthropic API key and read the reply in Raycast.

commands.name: ask-chatgpt
commands.title: Ask ChatGPT
commands.subtitle: OpenAI
commands.description: Ask ChatGPT with your OpenAI API key and read the reply in Raycast.

commands.name: ask-grok
commands.title: Ask Grok
commands.subtitle: xAI
commands.description: Ask Grok with your xAI API key and read the reply in Raycast.

commands.name: ask-ollama
commands.title: Ask Ollama
commands.subtitle: Local
commands.description: Ask a model running on your local Ollama server and read the reply in Raycast.

commands.name: ask-apple-intelligence
commands.title: Ask Apple Intelligence
commands.subtitle: Shortcuts
commands.description: Send a prompt to a Shortcuts shortcut that calls Apple Intelligence, then show the reply in Raycast.

commands.name: open-claude
commands.title: Open in Claude
commands.subtitle: Desktop app
commands.description: Open the Claude desktop app with your prompt filled in.

commands.name: open-chatgpt
commands.title: Open in ChatGPT
commands.subtitle: Desktop app
commands.description: Open the ChatGPT desktop app with your prompt filled in.

commands.name: manage-prompts
commands.title: Manage Saved Prompts
commands.subtitle: Personal AI
commands.description: Create, edit, and delete prompt templates stored on this Mac.

preferences.name: defaultProvider
preferences.title: Default Provider
preferences.description: Provider used by the Ask command until you pick another one in the window.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: Model id used when a command does not override it. Leave blank to use that provider's recommended model.

preferences.name: defaultThinking
preferences.title: Default Thinking
preferences.description: Thinking or reasoning level used until you override it in the Ask window.

preferences.name: customModelId
preferences.title: Custom Model
preferences.description: Optional model id added to the model dropdown for whichever provider you select.

preferences.name: ollamaBaseUrl
preferences.title: Ollama Base URL
preferences.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server. Installed models are loaded from /api/tags.

preferences.name: appleShortcutName
preferences.title: Apple Intelligence Shortcut
preferences.description: Name of the Shortcuts shortcut that receives your prompt and returns text. Apple Intelligence has no third-party HTTP API.

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: API key for Claude. Stored as a Raycast password. Create one in the Anthropic console.

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: API key for ChatGPT. Stored as a Raycast password. Create one in the OpenAI platform.

preferences.name: xaiApiKey
preferences.title: xAI API Key
preferences.description: API key for Grok. Stored as a Raycast password. Create one in the xAI console.
